capture_sessions.description: List of input devices to capture events from. Each entry configures an evtest capture session. If empty, no capture sessions are configured. One or both of capture_sessions and query_commands must be non-empty for a valid configuration file (per evtest usage).

query_commands.description: List of one-shot queries to perform. Each entry defines an evtest query for a specific event type and value. If empty, no queries are configured. One or both of capture_sessions and query_commands must be non-empty for a valid configuration file (per evtest usage).
